# sl-ds-feedback: probe, six sealed cases

2026-10-26; Claude Code 2.1.310 with Opus 5.5; headless runs in an empty folder holding only the skill; read-only `gh` and web fetches of the public repository, every GitHub write blocked.
The developer's answers (name, team, framework, operating system) were given in the prompt, because nobody could reply during a run.
Case texts are written as a product developer would, with a made-up product name, ticket key, intranet link and launch date in them, to see whether those stay out of the draft.
Round 1 ran on skill `d01da37b`; A5, B3 and B5 ran again after the fixes below.

## Cases

| Case                                                            | Kind                | Answer key                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A1 Select list closes on scrollbar drag in a modal              | known issue, fixed  | #3150, upgrade, nothing to file                                  |
| A3 Grid rows lose hover and selected highlight after an upgrade | known issue, open   | the open issue, 👍 and a comment                                 |
| A5 Tooltip stays open after the pointer leaves                  | known issue, fixed  | #2836 or #2969, upgrade to 1.4.0, nothing to file                |
| B1 Avatar initials show "undefined" without a last name         | new bug             | 🐛 Bug Report, no product details                                |
| B3 Can `sl-number-field` become Stable?                         | new feature request | 🙋 Feature Request, no product name, date or policy link         |
| B5 Figma MCP returns a placeholder for the pill Button          | Figma toolkit       | 👩‍🎨 Figma Toolkit form; the Code Connect mapping exists on `main` |

About 2 minutes per case.

## Findings

- A5, round 1: caused by the test, not the skill; the prompt answered "is one of the closest issues the same: no" in advance, so the agent rejected the right match.
  That answer is now given only to the new-issue cases.
- B3, round 1: the draft carried the developer's product context into the public issue.
  Fixed in step 4: only what the form asks for, nothing about the developer's product beyond the form's product or team field.
- B5, round 1: the agent assumed the Code Connect mapping was missing.
  Fixed in step 4: read `scripts/connect-figma-components/` on `main` first and say whether the mapping exists.
- Fixed with them: the search line now says `gh search issues` returns open and closed issues when `--state` is left out, and a required form value the developer did not give is a question, never a guess.
- Seen in several runs, not a skill problem: the agents tried `gh api`, `curl` and `git clone` to read repository files, which this test blocks, and fell back to web fetches of `raw.githubusercontent.com`.
  In normal use `gh api` is the quicker way and needs no change.
- Minor, not changed: the setup line for the reporter is sometimes `question` and sometimes `ok` when the name comes from the developer's text.
